comments.author: @AtlasLoreWorld
comments.text: The contrast between Baarle’s border running through ordinary streets and the colonial lines elsewhere really shows how different histories can create equally surprising maps. I make animated map explainers at Atlas Lore World, and I enjoyed how this video connects the border shapes to their backstories.

comments.author: @terraatlasofficial
comments.text: The Caprivi Strip one really stuck with me — an entire panhandle drawn on a map for a river trade route that turned out to be unusable. Colonial borders were basically drawn with vibes and guesswork.
